title: Equipment bonuses

settings.description: This feature has no settings; its curves are in the Curves section.
settings.title: Settings

curves.description: Named curves. The name must be one Tales uses, such as lastBastion.
curves.title: Curves

description: Curves that scale an equipment bonus, such as Last Bastion's armor boost as health drops.
x-help:
Each curve is named in Tales' code (for example lastBastion). Its x axis is the player's health as a fraction (0 to 1) and its y axis is the bonus. Edit the points to change how strong the bonus is at each health.

Only the curve names Tales knows are used; a new name has no effect.
